paite: TOUPA phat un. Aw TOUPA sikhate aw, phat unla, TOUPA min phat un.
heading: TOUPA Hoihna Phatna

paite: TOUPA min phat in om hen, tu a kipan tangtawn in.
Nisuahna a kipan atumna pha in, TOUPA min phat ding ahi.
TOUPA nam chihte tung ah tungnungpek ahi a, athupina in vante akhup tham ahi.
Tunglam a tutphah nei, TOUPA i Pathian bang kua ahia,
van a thil omte leh lei a thil omte en ding a kua kihihniam ahia?
Ama'n genthei leivui a kipan akaithou a, tagah eklei a kipan adomkang hi.
Miliante kiang a omsak theihna ding in, amite miliante kiang ngei ah.
Ama'n numei chiing inn-le-lou akepsak a, tu leh ta neinu bang in nuamsatak in abawl hi. TOUPA phat un.
